issues.title: FY2024/25 '12-month' yield 16.62 t/ha is really 11 months
issues.detail: PA section 8 gives last year's same period (May 2024–Mar 2025, 11 months) as 26,705.49 t = 16.62 t/ha (26,705.49 / 1,607.14 = 16.617). Agro Table 15 prints the same 16.62 t/ha as the full FY2024/25 yield (Period 12, to Apr 2026 heading). The figures reproduce exactly on the 11-month tonnage, so the Agro 'full year' is a part year. Dashboard: FY2024/25 removed from the full-year yield history. The Agro +25% FY2025/26 gain (20.81 vs 16.62) compares 12 months with 11 and is overstated.

issues.title: Agro Table 16 FY2025/26 total 5.50 t/ha does not match its fields
issues.detail: Agro Table 16 (May–Jul): field yields for FY2025/26 (6.45, 6.09, 6.48, 5.70, 4.81, 5.47, 4.92, 6.12, 1.35) area-weighted give 5.72 t/ha, not the printed 5.50. The other totals in Tables 15 and 16 (16.62, 20.81, 3.83) do reproduce. With 5.72 the FY2026/27 decline is -33%, not -30% as stated in 5.8 and the summary.

issues.title: Agro Table 15 period: February or April 2026

issues.title: Upkeep table total double-counts weeding and manuring
issues.detail: PA 2/2026 section 6 (p.17): printed Total Upkeep & Maintenance RM1,939,113.31 (RM1,207/ha) vs budget RM2,482,516 (RM1,545/ha). The listed lines add to RM1,310,575.98 actual and RM1,506,416 budget; the difference (RM628,537 actual) is the weeding (RM128,030.39) and manuring (RM500,506) group lines counted on top of their sub-lines. Section 9's RM165.52/t (budget 119.84) reproduces only on the correct totals (1,310,575.98 / 7,918.01; 1,506,416 / 12,570), so the true upkeep is about RM815 vs 937/ha, not 1,207 vs 1,545. Dashboard shows the printed RM/ha with this note.
